files.description: Official (b)(10) EHI export data dictionary. Excel workbook with 4 sheets: iKnowMed (236 tables, 5,275 columns), VBC (5 tables, 60 columns), Patient History (6 tables, 178 columns), Ontada Health (2 collections, 166 fields). This is the primary artifact documenting the pipe-delimited flat file export format.
HTML source of the EHI Export Capabilities page. Contains a brief description of the export format (ZIP with pipe-delimited files) and a link to the data dictionary.
Full-page screenshot of the EHI Export Capabilities page showing the page title, export description, data dictionary link, and content variability factors.
Bun TypeScript script that parses b10_data_dictionary.xlsx and produces structured JSON outputs. Deterministic and rerunnable.
Full structured extraction of all 249 entities and 5,679 fields from the data dictionary. Contains table names, column names, data types, lengths, and descriptions organized by source sheet.
Coverage and accounting summary: per-sheet table/column counts, complete table listing with column counts and descriptions, parse failure list (empty).
Run instructions, input/output documentation, and parsing notes for the enrichment scripts.
